title: Community Institutions, Social Infrastructure And Collective Resilience Registry
scope: Eight inactive community-institution dossiers, eight inactive civic-network and mutual-aid ledgers, eight inactive local-information integrity registers, and eight inactive collective-resilience ledgers downstream of Phase 82.
interpretation_boundary: Institution presence is not community access. Volunteer count is not mutual-aid capacity. Information volume is not public knowledge. Consultation is not collective governance. An emergency plan is not community preparedness. Reopening is not collective recovery.
activation_rule: At least one Phase 82 chain must contain a reviewed household-capability floor and service bundle, verified care-need and capacity baseline, workforce safeguards, complete household resource and time account, affordability and administrative-burden findings, neighborhood-access tests, displacement safeguards, crisis and recovery evidence, independent review, and receipts. Every Phase 83 institution, network, information, preparedness, recovery, remedy, and receipt decision remains separate and human-authorized.
